ac45b658cdd6e7d5.heading: Other taxable income for Self Assessment helpsheet (HS325)

amounts.name: Redundancy/termination payment exemption limit
amounts.ref: HS325 - Other payments in boxes 3 to 10

caveats: Losses on 'other income' can only be used against income of the same type, and expenses claimed under the trading income allowance cannot generate a loss.
Under Making Tax Digital for Income Tax, claims and adjustments for self-employment and property income are made through compatible software rather than the SA boxes described here.
Detailed conditions apply to third-party arrangement income taxable under box 3; taxpayer advised to seek tax adviser input.
Examples given (e.g. £10,000 redundancy, £40,000 redundancy with £1,000 PENP) are illustrative only; more complex cases require use of Working Sheet 2 or professional advice.

note.summary: HS325 explains how to work out figures for the 'other UK income' and 'additional information' sections of the SA tax return, covering miscellaneous/casual income, the £1,000 trading/miscellaneous income allowance, loss relief rules for other income, and employment lump sums including redundancy payments and post-employment notice pay. It provides worked examples for boxes 3-10 on redundancy payments against the £30,000 exemption and directs users to working sheets 1 and 2. It also notes that under Making Tax Digital for Income Tax, self-employment and property income will be handled via quarterly digital updates instead of these SA boxes.
